definitions.gloss: to notify, to inform, to let know
definitions.explanation: To communicate information to someone, to make someone aware of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{知|し}らせて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let me know the results.

examples.english: I informed him of the meeting time.

examples.notes: {知|し}らせ is the noun form

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). This is the causative-like form of {知|し}る (to know). Pattern: Xに Yを{知|し}らせる (inform X of Y).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action. {知|し}らせている = 'has informed.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xを{知|し}らせる (notify of X)
・{知|し}らせてください (please let me know)
・お{知|し}らせ (notification, announcement—polite noun)
・{知|し}らせが{届|とど}く (news arrives)

RELATED:
・{知|し}る: to know, to learn (base verb)
・{知|し}らせ: notification, news (noun form)
・お{知|し}らせ: announcement (polite noun)

CONTRAST WITH {伝|つた}える:
・{知|し}らせる: to inform (make someone aware)
・{伝|つた}える: to convey, tell (pass on a message)

Both can mean 'inform,' but {伝|つた}える emphasizes the transfer of a message.

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {知|し}らせていませんでした
